notes: Source for scripts/gen-audio.mjs (ElevenLabs). Write design/sound-design.md first. Every entry names its trigger, so the code wiring is clear. Audio is never the only signal: every sound has a visual twin.

sfx.prompt: Very short soft click of a small plastic switch, dry, close, clean, no music, no voice

sfx.trigger: SimEvent 'dodge': a block leaves the arena.
sfx.prompt: Tiny bright airy whoosh with a soft rising chime at the end, clean, short, no music, no voice

sfx.trigger: SimEvent 'hit': a block hits the player.
sfx.prompt: Short muffled thump with a low electronic buzz, not harsh, clearly negative, no music, no voice
Short descending three-note synth phrase, soft and calm, game over sting, no voice

music.trigger: The play screen while a run is active.
music.prompt: Minimal synthwave loop for a focused arcade game: steady pulsing bass, light arpeggio, soft pads, 110 BPM, A minor, instrumental, no lyrics, seamless loop, no intro, no ending, no fade-out, constant intensity
